description: This file defines mock overload structures for the Abseil C++ library's random internal components, facilitating overload resolution and mocking of distribution functions using gMock.

classes.name: MockSingleOverload
classes.description: Template struct for mocking a single overload of a distribution function.

classes.name: MockOverloadSet
classes.description: Template struct for handling a set of overloads for a distribution, enabling overload resolution.

methods.name: gmock_Call
methods.description: Method to invoke gMock's call mechanism for a specific overload.
